title: EdgeBridge x Redwood - Marketplace & Integration Sync
summary: Partner sync to align on marketplace listing steps, reference architecture artifacts (AMI vs container), billing integration options, security docs, and an initial joint benchmark plan. Redwood to provide listing template and reference arch draft; EdgeBridge to share security pack and container image. Agree to follow-up review and pilot timeline.
next_steps: Redwood: share marketplace listing template + example copy by 2026-12-22
EdgeBridge: provide security artifacts (SOC2 report + network diagram) by 2026-12-28
Redwood & EdgeBridge: schedule review of listing draft w/ marketing 2027-01-05
SEs to run initial integration bench (throughput/latency) and share results by 2027-01-12
action_items: Samir Patel - Share marketplace listing template and example reference architecture - due 2026-12-22
Maya Chen - Provide SOC2 report and network diagram, and point-of-contact for compliance - due 2026-12-28
Lena Ortiz - Provision test account and checklist for marketplace validation, start initial perf run - due 2026-12-29
Tomás Alvarez - Publish container image to test registry and share access - due 2026-12-23
Carlos Vega - Draft Terraform module reference for deploying Redwood connectors in EdgeBridge VPC - due 2027-01-06
transcript:
[00:00] Samir Patel: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, this is Samir from Redwood, i'm the AE on the account. we have Lena (SE) and Carlos from partner eng; quick intros?
[00:08] Maya Chen: hi Maya here head of platform at EdgeBridge, Tomás, Priya, Leo on from my side.
[00:15] Lena Ortiz: Hey all, i focus on integrations and marketplace flow, we'll walk through what Redwood needs to list and what the joint solution looks like.
[00:24] Tomás Alvarez: Good to be here, quick note our timeline is tight, we want listing live in jan feb window ideally.
[00:30] Samir Patel: Great, that's helpful. high level agenda: listing requirements, reference arch (AMI vs container), billing/metering, security artifacts, benchmarks and support.
[00:43] Priya Singh: For marketing we need a one pager and logo assets, simple. Also product screenshots maybe.
[00:49] Samir Patel: Yep, we'll share the marketplace listing template that includes fields marketing needs.
[00:55] Leo Martins: On security side, we need to know how data flows, where logs land, key mgmt, and if any host-level access is required.
[01:05] Carlos Vega: Good q — our private deployment options: we support hosted api, dedicated pools, and private VPC connectors. for marketplace we'd normally provide a container image (OCI) or a turnkey AMI depending on the marketplace.
[01:20] Tomás Alvarez: we're more container-first, we run k8s, so OCI image + helm or terraform is best for us.
[01:28] Lena Ortiz: perfect, for that we will propose a reference architecture: edgebridge VPC -> private connector -> redwood private runtime in customer subnet -> optional dedicated pool in redwood managed infra. we'll share diagram. (note: transcript may show K-V cash occasionally)
[01:45] Maya Chen: can you clarify the connector — is that a egress-only peering or vpn?
[01:49] Carlos Vega: usually we do VPC peering or private link depending on cloud. we support both. for marketplace listing we will document options.
[01:58] Tomás Alvarez: what about billing? do we integrate with marketplace metering or do we invoice direct?
[02:05] Samir Patel: two patterns: 1) marketplace metered billing (Redwood emits usage reports, marketplace invoices customer) or 2) direct billing with marketplace listing as marketing lead. we prefer marketplace metered for simplifed customer flow but need to confirm marketplace's metering API.
[02:20] Priya Singh: ok that affects pricing and revenue share. we need sample SLA and pricing tiers in the listing draft.
[02:28] Lena Ortiz: we'll include pricing tier suggestions (hosted vs dedicated) and notes on performance. also include recommended quantization/instance families for cost guidance.
[02:38] Tomás Alvarez: on perf — we want baseline numbers: p95 latency for 1k token context, throughput per GPU, and cost per 1k tokens. can redwood run quick bench?
[02:46] Carlos Vega: yes we'll run a short benchmark with the model variants; initial test in our test registry env should cover throughput/latency. lena will own test orchestration.
[02:54] Maya Chen: security artifacts — we'll need SOC2, ISO if available, audit logs, SSO/SAML or OIDC for SSO, RBAC mapping, and KMS integration.
[03:05] Samir Patel: Redwood provides SOC2 Type II, SAML SSO, RBAC and KMS integrations (customer-managed KMS supported for Private). we'll attach the security pack.
[03:14] Leo Martins: good — also need to know what logs are exported for audit, retention windows, and whether logs can be shipped to our logging endpoint.
[03:22] Lena Ortiz: yes we support log forwarding to customer endpoints and configurable retention. we'll list specifics in the security doc.
[03:28] Priya Singh: for the listing we'll need a reference arch diagram, technical bullets, install steps, and a short joint solution narrative. can redwood provide a 1-page reference arc?
[03:36] Samir Patel: yep we'll draft a 1-page reference arch and a longer reference architecture repo with terraform/helm examples.
[03:42] Tomás Alvarez: quick question on private deployments: if we run on-prem, is there an air-gapped option?
[03:47] Carlos Vega: yes — we have an on-prem package that supports air-gapped installs; that'll be documented in the repo. some kernel-level optimizations for quantized models might differ but functionally it's the same.
[03:57] Maya Chen: great. about marketplace publishing — who writes the listing copy and approves it?
[04:02] Samir Patel: we usually provide a draft copy and marketing assets, then partner marketing reviews and finalizes. we'll coordinate a joint review.
[04:11] Priya Singh: do you have a checklist for the marketplace validation steps? those validation windows can block us.
[04:16] Lena Ortiz: yes we have a validation checklist (security, billing, image scans, integration tests). i'll attach that to the template.
[04:24] Tomás Alvarez: container image scannings — do you require an SBOM?
[04:28] Carlos Vega: we request SBOM and vulnerability scan reports for marketplace images; we'll include exact requirements in the doc.
[04:35] Samir Patel: on joint go-to-market, marketing wants a reference customer story and a short tech blog, possible to coordinate after we run initial pilot.
[04:44] Maya Chen: yes we can do a pilot and produce a joint case study after success.
[04:49] Lena Ortiz: notes on testing: we'll run an integration test suite that hits auth, request routing, KV cache behavior, and failover to hosted model variants. some transcriptions might show K-V cash but it's KV cache.
[04:59] Tomás Alvarez: that's important because we have cold-start concerns on serverless containers.
[05:03] Carlos Vega: we'll recommend pre-warming and cross-zone pools for critical routes. also share guidance on batching settings to hit cost targets.
[05:13] Priya Singh: about support SLAs — what's included for marketplace listings?
[05:17] Samir Patel: for initial listings we include standard support; for Dedicated/Private we offer premium support SLAs as an add-on with 24/7 pager and SLOs. we'll attach SLA options.
[05:28] Maya Chen: ok scope for pilot: deploy container image to our test k8s namespace, run perf tests, validate SSO and log forwarding, verify billing reports. timeline one-two weeks for initial perf.
[05:40] Samir Patel: sounds good, lena and tomás will coordinate; i'll send calendar invite for the perf run kickoff.
[05:46] Priya Singh: any blockers we foresee?
[05:49] Leo Martins: need to review network egress and firewall rules, and confirm access to artifact registry.
[05:54] Carlos Vega: noted, we'll provide a network checklist.
[05:58] Samir Patel: ok to recap next steps: we will share the listing template, reference arch draft, and security pack. EdgeBridge to share SOC2, container image and test access. schedule follow-up review in early jan.
[06:12] Maya Chen: agreed. thanks all.
[06:15] Samir Patel: thanks, meeting adjourned.
